svg.aria-label: C4 level 2, containers: Caddy and one application image running the api, gateway and worker roles; scheduler, apps-runner, egress-proxy and surface-bot sidecars; chat sandboxes and hosted data apps spawned at runtime; app state in Postgres or DuckDB, the extracts tree, the analytics plane and a coordination backend; and, outside the server boundary, the analyst laptop's CLI, local DuckDB and Claude Code workspace.
